comment: EPO03 PROD-WORLD-EAST pending regions (never a manifest). Territory 600-1024 x 0-700 (DIR-01). Crop coords as ATLAS_PRODUCTION_RULES s2. `cut` is read by tools/atlas-maskcut.js AFTER atlas-mask.js: open sea beyond cut.seaMargin px of any land/ice body >= cut.minLand px is forced to 0 so the sea is never authorized (the FMPO02 N3 lesson), and cut.holes (atlas px) are hard 0 over identity features whose protection coreAuthor/reauthorizes lifted. The PixelLab mask src/atlas/<id>_inpaint.png is the inpaint rect minus open sea beyond cut.inpaintMargin minus the holes inflated by cut.holeInflate. Salts 100-119 belong to EAST.

verify.what: Rimespire prop must still have ice, not open water, under it (DIR-01 anchor). No hole: a frozen 30px square inside a 50px ribbon reads as a patch. Verified on the composite instead.

regions.intent: The front itself. Rolls 1-2 proved a wide ice mask is answered with a generator pattern (a smooth slab, then a fresh dark honeycomb), so the third intent is a RIBBON: the authorization is cut to a band straddling the ice margin (landMargin 26 / seaMargin 24) and the pack interior is frozen. The tool has room only for the edge - a graded face, bergs of several sizes calving off it, brash thinning seaward, leads reaching back into the margin.

The honeycomb. The regular crack-cell net over the pack ice becomes one broad sheet of old fast ice: wide smooth snow-covered ice carrying long low wind-drift bands in one direction, with only a few long single cracks wandering at shallow angles and never meeting. Deliberately SMALL (120x120 authored) because E1 rolls 1-2 proved a wide ice mask is answered with a pattern.

freezeDark.why: rock and both towers sit at L*<30 on this crop, everything else at L*>50; freezing them makes DIR-01 identity mechanical after roll 1 rebuilt the cone

regions.intent: Rolls 1 and 2 both failed (rebuilt the cone; invented an antler-shaped object), so E2 ships WITHOUT a generation: the dithered seam smear at atlas 630-755 x 234-286 is removed by atlas-fleck.js --dither, a modal snap to an existing neighbouring colour (A-2). The rock silhouette and both towers stay byte-exact via cut.freezeDark. The authored ash/steam join did NOT close and is reported as such.
